text:
The net production of ATP by substrate-level phosphorylation in glycolysis is 2 ATP per glucose. Hexokinase and phosphofructokinase consume two ATP, while phosphoglycerate kinase and pyruvate kinase form four. From glycogen the same route yields a net of 3 ATP per glucosyl unit, because phosphorolysis bypasses the hexokinase step.

CONFIDENCE: 96
